{{recipe}}

{{decameron}}

==Ingredients==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] dried white [[Cookbook:Beans|beans]] (haricot or flagelot, not lima or butter beans)
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* [[Cookbook:Butter|Butter]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Carrot|carrot]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], halved
* 2 [[Cookbook:Leek|leeks]], in chunks
* 1 stalk [[Cookbook:Celery|celery]]
* [[Cookbook:Chicken|Chicken]] or [[Cookbook:Veal|veal]] [[Cookbook:Stock|stock]]
* 3 [[Cookbook:Egg Yolk|egg yolks]]
* 1 cup [[Cookbook:Cream|cream]]
* [[Cookbook:Peas|Peas]], [[Cookbook:Boiling|boiled]]
* [[Cookbook:Crouton|Croûtons]]
==Procedure==
# Soak beans in water for 12 hours, then drain them.
# Add the drained beans to a stock pot with a little salt, butter, carrot, onion, two leeks, and a stick of celery.
# Cover with water, and [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]] until the vegetables are well cooked.
# Drain the beans and vegetables, discarding the vegetables.
# [[Cookbook:Puréeing|Purée]] the beans, adding stock as necessary to get a smooth consistency.
# Transfer purée to a pot, and add stock to get the desired consistency. Bring to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]], and keep hot until serving.
# Combine the egg yolks with the cream, and add this to the soup.
# Transfer the soup to a warm tureen, add some boiled green peas, and serve with fried croûtons handed separately.
